top_signals.title: Apple Overtakes Nvidia to Become World’s Most Valuable Company
top_signals.summary: Apple Inc. reclaimed the title of world’s most valuable company on Friday, taking the mantle from Nvidia Corp. as investors seek the perceived safety of the iPhone maker amid concerns about artificial intelligence spending.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Dermatology Biotech Bambusa Dips 6.3% After $168.9 Million IPO
top_signals.summary: Bambusa Therapeutics Inc. shares slipped 6.3% in its trading debut after the early-stage biotech focused on dermatology and autoimmune diseases raised $168.9 million in a US initial public offering.
